impacts.statement: Stages above 73.0 feet result in major flooding of the area outside the levees. Top of levee.
Water moves into parking lot and patio of RV Park located 0.7 miles downstream of gauge on left bank of river.
Water impacts the parking lot of RV Park 4 miles downstream of gauge on left bank of river. RV Park is located inside the levee.
Monitor Stage. The Colusa-Sacramento River State Recreation Area begins to experience high water impacts.
